reviews.text: A peaceful, safe, and welcoming place where your dogs make lots of friends and have lots of fun.

I received excellent service from the very beginning, before, during, and after boarding my two dogs at Casarão. During their stay, I received several photos, and it was clear how much they cared for the pets. Bento and Kiara returned home happy and tired! Everyone is very careful and attentive. Thank you so much!

I want to share my experience and that of my dog, Lito, at the Casarão Pet Daycare, because it's essential to feel secure knowing that our pet is well treated/cared for. I feel that this work is done with love and great dedication!
My dog ​​feels happy to be in the daycare and boarding environment with other equally happy dog ​​friends. We receive photos and videos throughout the day, easing the longing and being certain of the care they receive!
Thank you so much to the whole team for the affection shown to my Lito!!

My dog's trainer recommended Pet Casarão to me, and since then I've only had good things to say about them! My dog ​​attends daycare and has also stayed there before. The entire Pet Casarão team is super attentive and caring with our pets.

One thing I really like is that there's always a monitor accompanying the dogs, and they are separated by size and also according to age, between puppies and adults. This gives me a lot of security and peace of mind, because I know they are being supervised and that the interaction happens in appropriate groups. My dog ​​loves Pet Casarão!
Excellent

Whenever I need to travel, I leave our dog at Pet Casarão. Besides providing a great, gradual adaptation process, respecting each animal's limits, they are very affectionate and keep us updated with super funny photos and captions. I highly recommend them!
Wonderful people and service! They took care of my dog ​​for 5 nights. Super attentive and careful. They sent photos and videos every day, my dog ​​came back calm and happy <3 Thank you!

Fabrício and the entire team welcomed Luppy (Pomeranian) very well and reassured us about the entire routine and care Luppy received during his one-week stay at Pet Casarão. They always sent photos and videos and promptly answered our questions. It was a positive experience, and Luppy will definitely return to Pet Casarão when needed.

Pet Casarão is excellent; I trust Fabrício and his team to take care of my dogs so I can travel with peace of mind knowing they'll be okay. The place is great, clean, and completely adapted for dogs to have fun and socialize, making daycare a great option so they don't spend the day bored at home. I highly recommend it!

I highly recommend it! After some frustrating experiences at other daycares, I found a place I truly trust. The care for the dogs is exceptional, the staff is extremely attentive, qualified, and shows genuine affection for the pets. I travel from Barra da Tijuca to take my pet to Botafogo because I have complete confidence that she will be very well cared for. Exemplary professionals and a service that makes all the difference! 🐾❤️

Pet Casarao surprised me. Very clean and organized, I can drop off and pick up my pet at the most convenient time for my needs, which helps me tremendously. They are always available and attentive. I always receive a smile!

I would like to thank the entire team at PET daycare Casarão for their care and affection towards Link! 🐶
We were delighted 🥰 with the videos and photos! The furry friends are adorable! And Vanessa does a fantastic job with the photos and videos!

Link 🐶 returned home 🏠 feeling great and happy!

He will definitely come back many more times!

Thank you so much 😊 💕

I highly recommend them. The attentive staff takes great care of the pets. I've used both their daycare and boarding services, and in both cases my dog ​​ate well, got some rest, and always showed interest in coming in whenever we passed by.

A Cavalier King Charlie Spaniel suffers greatly when left alone for long periods. I work all week, and when I decided to get a puppy of this breed, I knew I would need a doggy daycare. I found Pet Casarão through Google and its reviews and scheduled a visit. Since then, it's been nothing but joy! I recommend them without hesitation. Hanna loves it there and comes home exhausted from so many games and activities. The affection and care they have for each animal allows me to work peacefully knowing that my dog ​​is safe and happy. The attention to detail in the themed parties, without humanizing the dog, is sensational. The fun is for them, and the decoration is for us! The videos and photos I receive when Hanna is at daycare fill my day with joy. To the professionals at Pet Casarão, I leave here my heartfelt thanks.
Tinker Bell and Amy had so much fun, were very well taken care of, and came back exhausted! Wonderful! 🤗 …

My little dog Pico loves Casarão. I leave him there some weekends and he goes in all happy. Fabricio welcomed us very well. The monitors are always very friendly and take good care of Pico. I recommend it!

Accommodation and daycare are top-notch! Super personalized treatment with lots of attention and care!

I recommend it to everyone.

Attentive and caring professionals, they always organize some activity, whether it's a day at the pool, a circuit, a scent work activity... and we receive photos and videos of everything! My Pippa loves it!! I leave her with peace of mind! ❤️
So much affection, care, and attention given to my little dog. A historic and well-preserved place. I felt like I was in a Machado de Assis novel in the 21st century. Thank you.
We loved the warm welcome Tito received. Wonderful team!
